title: GOD, EASE MY MIND AND CALM MY SPIRIT
text: Beloved, I greet you in the matchless name of our Lord Jesus Christ. I want you to know that you are not on this broadcast [music] by accident. The fact that you are connected to this frequency this morning is a divine orchestration. There is something that heaven wants to communicate to your spirit, and I pray that as we journey together in the next few moments, the God who neither slumbers nor sleeps will visit your situation with unusual mercy. I want to speak to someone this morning whose mind has become a battlefield. [music] Your thoughts have become weapons of warfare against your own destiny. You wake up, and before your feet touch the ground, anxiety has already taken its seat in the courtroom of your mind. Before you even begin your day, there is already a conversation happening in your head that is draining your spiritual vitality, that is suffocating [music] your faith, that is strangling your joy. The Bible says in Philippians chapter 4 verse 6 and 7, "Be careful for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus." [music] I want you to understand something this morning. God is not just interested in keeping your heart. He's interested in keeping your mind. Your mind is the gateway to your destiny. Your mind is the control room of your existence. Everything you will ever become is first processed in the laboratory of your mind. The enemy knows that if he can capture your thoughts, he has captured your future. If he can dominate your mental space, he has dominated your destiny. This is why the scripture says we should cast down imaginations and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. The Christian life is not just about what you do with your hands. It is about what you do with your mind. There are people watching me right now, and you have not known rest in your mind for months. Some of you, it has been years. You lay down on your bed at night and your mind begins to race with scenarios that have not happened, with conversations that have not taken place, with outcomes that God has not ordained. The spirit of worry has moved into your mental space and has set up a throne. Fear has established a headquarters in your thought life. Let me tell you what the Lord showed me in prayer. Every restless mind is an indication [music] of a displaced trust. When your mind cannot rest, it is because your trust is not fully anchored in God. You see, peace is not the absence of problems. Peace is the presence of God in the midst of problems. The disciples were in a storm and they were panicking, but Jesus was in the same boat sleeping. Same storm, different responses. The difference was not the storm. The difference was the consciousness of who was in the boat with them. I prophesy to someone right now, you will become conscious of the presence of [music] God in your storm. That awareness will shift everything. When you know that God is with you, when you know that the all-sufficient one is backing you, when you know that El Shaddai, the God who is more than enough, has taken responsibility for your case, your mind will cease from its restless wandering. Isaiah chapter 26:3 says, "Thou will keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee because he [music] trusted in thee." Perfect peace, not partial peace. Not temporary peace. Not circumstantial peace. Perfect peace. The Hebrew word for perfect peace is shalom shalom, double peace, reinforced peace, peace upon peace. This is the peace that doesn't make sense to the natural mind. This is the peace that causes you to sleep when you should be worried. This is the peace that causes you to smile when circumstances say you should be breaking down. But notice the condition, whose mind is stayed on thee. Your mind must be stayed. [music] It must be fixed. It must be established. It must be anchored. A stayed mind is not a mind that is tossed to and fro by every wind of circumstance. A stayed mind is not a mind that is dominated by the news, by economic reports, by medical diagnosis, by relationship uncertainties. A stayed mind is a mind that has found its resting [music] place in God. Let me speak to the person whose spirit has been troubled. You know, there is a difference between your mind and your spirit. Your mind is your intellectual faculty. Your spirit is your God consciousness. Your spirit is that part of you that connects with the [music] divine. When your spirit is troubled, it means there is a disconnection somewhere. There is static in your spiritual frequency. There is noise in your communion with heaven. Jesus said in John chapter 14 verse 27, "Peace I leave with you. My peace I give unto you. Not as the world giveth, give I unto you. [music] Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid." Notice, he didn't say your heart will not be troubled. He said, "Let not your heart be troubled." This means you have a responsibility. You have a choice. Trouble will come knocking, but you don't have to open the door. Anxiety will come presenting its case, but you don't have to give it a seat at your table. The peace of God is not something you manufacture, it is something you receive. Jesus said, "My peace I give unto you. It is a gift. It is a legacy. It is an inheritance that was purchased at Calvary." [music] When Jesus said, "It is finished," he was not just talking about the forgiveness of sins. He was talking about the restoration of peace between God and man. He was talking about the availability of divine rest for the troubled soul. I want to pray for someone right now, but before I pray, I need you to understand something. This prayer will work for you only if you participate. Prayer is not a spectator sport. You cannot be passive in the place of prayer and expect maximum results. I need you to lift up your hands wherever you are. I don't care if you're driving, keep one hand on the wheel, but lift the other one. I don't care if you're in a public place, this is your moment with God. Your breakthrough is more important than the opinion of people who don't even know your story. I need you to share this broadcast right now with at least three people who need this word. There is someone in your contact list whose mind has been tormented by the enemy. There is someone you know whose spirit has been weighed down by the cares of this world. Don't be selfish with this prophetic ministry. The anointing on this word is designed to break yolks. Send it to them now. Tag them. Share it on your timeline. Let this word locate someone who needs it. Now, let me pray. Father, I thank you because you are the God of all comfort. You are the lifter of our heads. You are the one who gives songs in the night season. I come before you this morning on behalf of every mind that has been under siege, every thought pattern that has been programmed by the enemy, I command a divine reset in the name of Jesus. Every imagination that has exalted itself against the knowledge of God, I pull it down by the authority of the word. [music] I speak to every spirit of anxiety that has been assigned to torment the minds of your children. I command you to lose your hold right now in the name of Jesus. Every fear that has taken residence in the mental space of the believer, I evict you by fire. You have no legal ground. You have no authority. The blood of Jesus has canceled your assignment. Father, I decree perfect peace upon every troubled mind. Let the peace that passes understanding begin to garrison the hearts and minds of your people. Every chemical imbalance that the enemy is using as a weapon, I command divine realignment in the name of Jesus. Every hormonal attack, every neurological oppression, I speak the healing power of God. Let there be restoration from the crown of the head to the sole of the feet. I prophesy to someone that sleepless night is ending today. You will sleep the sleep of the righteous. Your rest will be sweet. Your dreams will be prophetic. The torment ends now in the name of Jesus. Now, let me minister to you from the word. Turn with me in your spirit to the book of Psalms chapter 94. The psalmist said something very powerful in verse 19. In the multitude of my thoughts within me, thy comforts delight my soul. In the multitude of my thoughts, he's acknowledging that the thoughts were many, they were overwhelming, they were like a multitude, like a crowd, like an [music] army. But in the midst of that mental warfare, divine comfort came. You see, God doesn't always remove the battle. Sometimes he gives you the grace to win the battle. He doesn't always stop the thoughts from coming. He gives you the weapon to take those thoughts captive. The comfort of God is not just emotional relief. It is spiritual reinforcement. It is divine strength imparted to your inner man, so that you can stand in the evil day. There is someone here, and the Lord is showing me that your mind has been a rehearsal room for worst-case scenarios. [music] You have rehearsed failure more than you have rehearsed success. You have rehearsed rejection more than you have rehearsed acceptance. You have rehearsed loss more than you have rehearsed gain. The enemy has turned your imagination into a cinema where he keeps playing horror movies about your future. But I come as a prophet of the most high God to tell you the script is changing today. The narrative is shifting. God is giving you a new movie to watch. It is called kingdom victory. It is called supernatural turnaround. It is called divine vindication. You will begin to imagine good things. You will begin to see yourself winning. You You begin to rehearse testimonies >> [music] >> instead of tragedies. The Bible says in Jeremiah chapter 29 verse 11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you said the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end." God has thoughts toward you and his thoughts are not thoughts of evil, they are thoughts of peace. God is not imagining your downfall, he's imagining your elevation. God is not planning your destruction, he's planning your establishment. Let me tell you something that will bless you. The reason God can have peaceful thoughts toward you is because he has already seen the end from the beginning. He knows how your story concludes. He has read the final chapter. He knows that you win, he knows that you make it, he knows that you overcome. So, while you are panicking about chapter three, God is relaxed because he has already read chapter 20 and in chapter 20 you are testifying. This is why you must learn to access the peace of God. Peace is not just a feeling, it is a person. Jesus himself is our peace. Ephesians chapter 2 verse 14 says, "For he is our peace." Not he gives peace, not he offers peace, he is peace. When you have Jesus, you have peace. When you are abiding in him, you are abiding in peace. Someone needs to hear this. The restlessness in your spirit is because you have moved out of the secret place. You used to pray more, you used to worship more, you used to fellowship with God more. But the cares of this world, the deceitfulness of riches, the pursuit of daily bread has choked your communion with heaven and now you are running on empty. You are operating in your own strength and it is not sustainable. Psalm 91 verse one says, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty." The secret place is not a physical location, it is a spiritual position. It is a place of intimacy with God. It is that place where you shut out the noise of the world and tune in to the frequency of heaven. And when you dwell there, not visit, not tour, not occasionally show up, but dwell there, you abide under the shadow of the Almighty. The shadow speaks of covering. >> [music] >> It speaks of protection. It speaks of rest. Have you ever been outside on a very hot day and you step into the shadow of a tree and immediately you feel relief? That's what happens when you dwell in the secret place. The heat of life's challenges may be intense, but under his shadow, there is coolness. There is rest. There is refreshing. I prophesy to someone, God is calling you back to the secret place. He's calling you back to that place of intimate fellowship. He's calling you back to that place where it's just you and him, no agenda, no shopping list of requests, just worship, just communion, just fellowship. And when you return to that place, your mind will find its rest, your spirit will find its calm. Let me go deeper in the spirit. [music] There are some people your problem is not just that you think too much. Your problem is what you are thinking about. You are meditating on the wrong things. You are feeding your mind with poisonous content. You scroll through social media for hours consuming bad news, negative reports, comparison content, and then you wonder why your spirit is agitated. The Bible gives us very clear instruction in Philippians chapter 4 verse 8. Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report, [music] if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things. Think on these things. This is a command. You have to police your thought life. You have to be intentional about what you allow into your mental space. The enemy doesn't need your permission to send thoughts. He will throw them at you like arrows, but you have the power to accept or reject those thoughts. You have the power to meditate on them or dismiss them. David said in Psalm 1:2, speaking about the blessed man, but his delight is in the law of the Lord, and in his law doth he meditate day and night. Meditation is the key to transformation. What you meditate on you become. If you meditate on fear, you will become fearful. If you meditate on failure, you will attract failure. But if you [music] meditate on the word of God, if you meditate on his promises, if you meditate on his faithfulness, you will be transformed into the image of what you are beholding. There is a supernatural principle that many believers don't understand. Your mind is a garden, and whatever you plant in it will grow. If you plant seeds of worry, you will harvest a crop of anxiety. If you plant seeds of doubt, you will harvest a crop of unbelief. But if you plant seeds of faith, if you plant seeds of the word, if you plant seeds of praise and worship, you will harvest a crop of peace, joy, and righteousness. Let me tell you what the Lord showed me about calm. Calm is not the absence of storm. Calm is the presence of divine authority. When Jesus spoke to the storm and said, "Peace, be still." He was not speaking to the weather. He was releasing divine authority over chaos. And the Bible says the wind ceased, and there was a great calm. The same authority that Jesus exercised over the natural storm is available to you to exercise over the storm in your mind. You can speak to your thoughts. You can command your emotions. You can decree peace to your inner world. This is not positive thinking. This is the application of kingdom authority. Mark chapter 11:23 says, "For verily I say unto you, that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou removed and be thou cast into the sea and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he sayeth shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he sayeth." Did you see that? You shall have whatsoever you say. Your words are creating your reality. You have been saying, "I am so worried. I am so anxious. I can't sleep. I can't focus. I am falling apart." And with your own mouth, you are reinforcing the very condition you are trying to escape. But today, I am teaching you a new language. I am teaching you the language of faith. I am teaching you the language of divine decree. From today, you will begin to say, "The Lord is my peace. My mind is stayed on him. I will not be moved. I will not be [music] shaken. I am kept by the power of God. I sleep in peace. I wake up refreshed. My spirit is calm. My mind is clear. I am walking in divine rest." When you change [music] your confession, you change your condition. When you align your mouth with heaven's reality, you bring heaven's reality into your earth. This is not magic. This is faith. This is how the kingdom operates. Let me minister to someone about a specific attack. There are people watching me and you have been experiencing what I call mental bombardment. The enemy has been flooding your mind with rapid-fire thoughts one after the other, no break, no rest. The moment you dismiss one thought, another one comes. It's like a machine gun of negative thinking. This is a calculated demonic strategy. The goal is to overwhelm you, to exhaust you, to break down your resistance until you accept those thoughts as your reality. But I have come as a messenger of the Lord to tell you, you are not a victim of your thoughts. You are the gatekeeper of [music] your mind. Second Corinthians chapter 10 verse 5 says, "Casting down imaginations and every high thing that exalted itself against the knowledge of God and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. The word casting down in the Greek is katareo, which means to demolish, to destroy, to pull down with force. This is not a gentle suggestion. This is violent spiritual warfare. You have to be aggressive with wrong thoughts. You cannot be passive. You cannot be diplomatic. When a thought comes that contradicts the word of God, you don't negotiate with it. You don't analyze it. You cast it down. You demolish it. You take it captive. You arrest it and bring it to the obedience of Christ. Let me teach you something practical. When the enemy sends a thought of fear, immediately counter attack with scripture. If he says, "You're going to fail." You say, "No weapon formed against me shall prosper." If he says, "You're not going to make it." You say, "I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me." If he says, "God has forgotten you." You say, "I will never leave you nor forsake you." This is how you fight. This is how you win. You don't win by feeling better. You win by standing on the word regardless of how you feel. Faith is not an emotion. Faith is a position. It is a stance you take on the authority of God's word. I want to speak to someone whose spirit has been heavy. There is a weight on you that you cannot even explain. You wake up and you just feel heavy. Your joy is gone. Your motivation is low. You are going through the motions of life, but there is no fire, no passion, no zeal. The Bible calls this a spirit of heaviness. Isaiah chapter 61 verse 3 speaks about the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. Notice, it doesn't say the feeling of praise. It says the garment of praise. A garment is something you put on intentionally. You don't wait to feel like praising. you put on praise as an act of spiritual warfare. When you begin to praise God in the midst of heaviness, you are not being fake, you are being obedient. You are choosing to magnify God above your circumstances. And when you magnify God, your problems shrink in comparison. When you lift up the name of Jesus, the weight begins to lift off your spirit. I prophesy to someone right now, begin to praise him right where you are. Begin to worship him. Lift up your voice, clap your hands, stomp your feet if you have to. That heaviness is breaking, that depression is lifting, that discouragement is scattering. As you praise him, you are shifting atmospheres. As you worship him, you are releasing divine intervention. David understood this principle. In 1 Samuel chapter 30, when everything was falling apart, when his city was burned, when his family was taken captive, when his own men were talking about stoning him, the Bible says, "But David encouraged himself in the Lord his God." He didn't wait for someone to encourage him, he didn't wait for [music] a prophet to give him a word. He ministered to his own spirit. You have to learn how to minister to yourself. You have to learn how to preach to yourself. You have to learn how to prophesy to yourself. Get up in the morning and tell yourself, "This is the day the Lord has made. I will rejoice and be glad in it. The joy of the Lord is my strength. I am victorious. I am blessed. I am favored. I am covered. I am protected. I am empowered." Speak to your own soul like the psalmist did in Psalm 42:5, "Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted in me? Hope thou in God, for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance." David was having a conversation with himself. He was interrogating his own spirit. Why are you down? Why are you disturbed? Put your hope in God. This is spiritual intelligence. This is kingdom wisdom. You are not at the mercy of your emotions. You are not a slave to your feelings. You have authority over your inner world. Let me address something that the Holy Spirit is highlighting. There are people here and your mind is not at ease because you are carrying offenses. You are harboring unforgiveness. Someone hurt you, betrayed you, disappointed you and you have been replaying that situation in your mind over and over again. You have been rehearsing the pain. You have been nurturing and the enemy is using that unforgiveness as a legal ground to torment you. Jesus said in Matthew chapter 18 that if you don't forgive, you will be delivered to the tormentors. Unforgiveness opens the door to mental and emotional torment. It is a poison that you drink hoping the other person will die. But today, the Lord is giving you the grace to let it go. Forgiveness is not saying what they did was okay. Forgiveness is saying I am releasing them into the hands of God. I am no longer carrying the weight of this offense. I am freeing myself from this prison of bitterness. When you forgive, you are not doing the other person a favor. You are doing yourself a favor. You are unlocking your own peace. You are opening the door to your own healing. The Bible says in Ephesians chapter 4 verse 32, "And be you kind one to another, tender-hearted, forgiving one another even as God for Christ's sake had forgiven you." If God can forgive you for all your sins, you can forgive that person. If God can show you mercy when you didn't deserve it, you can extend mercy to someone who hurt you. This is not about your feelings. This is about your obedience. This is about your freedom. I want to pray a prayer of release right now. If there is anyone you need to forgive, I want you to say their name in your heart right now. Don't say it out loud. Just say it in your heart. And as I pray, release them. Let them go. Free yourself. Father, I thank you for the power of forgiveness. I thank you that you have given us the grace to let go of offenses. Right now, I pray for every person who is watching, everyone who is carrying the weight of unforgiveness, [music] I release the grace to forgive. By the authority of Jesus Christ, I break every chain of bitterness. I uproot every root of resentment. I cancel every assignment of the tormentor [music] in the name of Jesus. I decree that as they release those who have wronged them, you will release them into a new dimension of peace. Let the peace of God that passes all understanding flood their hearts and minds right now. Let there be freedom in their spirit. Let there be lightness where there was heaviness. Let there be joy where there was pain. Father, I thank you because you are restoring them. You are healing them. You are making them whole. They will not be defined by their pain. They will not be limited by their past. They are stepping into a new season of peace and clarity [music] in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen. Now, let me speak to you about divine exchange. When you come to God with your burdens, he doesn't just sympathize with you. He exchanges with you. He takes your heavy load and gives you his light yoke. He takes your anxiety and gives you his peace. He takes your confusion and gives you his clarity. 1 Peter chapter 5 verse 7 says, "Casting all your care upon him, for he careth for you." The word casting in the Greek is epirripto, [music] which means to hurl, to throw upon. This is not a gentle laying down. This is a forceful release. You are throwing your cares upon him because you are not designed to carry them. Many believers are struggling because they are trying to carry what God never asked them to carry. You are trying to figure out what only God can figure out. You are trying to fix what only God can fix. You are trying to control what only God can control. And the weight of playing God in your own life is crushing you. But when you cast your cares upon [music] him, when you truly release them, when you stop picking them back up every 5 minutes, you will experience a lightness that you haven't felt in years. You will sleep better. You will think clearer. You will operate with more wisdom and less stress. Jesus said in Matthew chapter 11:28-30, "Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn of me, for I am meek and lowly in heart, and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light." This is an invitation. This is not a suggestion. Jesus is saying, "Come. Not try harder. Not figure it out. Not pull yourself together. Just come. Come as you are. Come with your mess. Come with your confusion. Come with your broken pieces. Come and find rest." And notice it says, "You shall find rest unto your souls." Your soul is your mind, your will, your emotions. This is where the battle is raging. This is where the turmoil is happening. But Jesus is offering you soul rest, not physical rest, not external rest, but deep internal rest, where your soul is at peace even when circumstances are chaotic. Let me share something with you that changed my life. I learned that worry is actually a form of pride. [music] You might say, "Pastor, what do you mean?" Think about it. When you worry, you are essentially saying, "God, I don't think you can handle this. I don't think you are big enough for this problem. I don't trust your ability to come through for me." That is pride masquerading as concern. Humility says, "God, this is beyond me, but it is not beyond you. [music] I don't know what to do, but you do. I can't fix this, but you can. So, I am going to trust you." That is the posture that accesses grace. The Bible says God resists the proud but gives grace to the humble. When you humble yourself under the mighty hand of God, when you admit that you don't have all the answers, when you surrender control and trust his sovereignty, grace is released. And grace is the supernatural ability to handle what you cannot handle in your own strength. I need to speak to someone about the warfare in your sleep. You go to bed and your mind starts racing. You can't turn it off. The moment your head hits the pillow, it's like a switch flips and a thousand thoughts flood your mind. You replay conversations from 10 years ago. You worry about things that might happen next year. You calculate scenarios that have a 0% chance of occurring. This is not natural. This is a spiritual attack. The enemy knows that if he can steal your sleep, he can steal your strength. If he can keep you up at night, you will be ineffective during the day. Sleep deprivation is one of his favorite weapons because it makes you vulnerable, irritable, and weak. But Psalm 127:2 says, "It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows. For so he giveth his beloved sleep." God gives his beloved sleep. Not tossing and turning, not staring at the ceiling, not checking your phone every 15 minutes sleep. Deep, restful, restorative sleep. I decree over your life right now. You will sleep. The spirit of insomnia is broken. The assignment to steal your rest is canceled. You will lay down and your sleep will be sweet. You will wake up refreshed and renewed. The peace of God will guard your mind as you sleep in the name of Jesus. Let me give you a practical weapon. Before you go to bed, spend time in the word. Don't let the last thing you consume be social media, the news, or a stressful conversation. Let the The thing you feed [music] your spirit be the word of God. Read a psalm, meditate on a promise, declare a scripture over your life. When you go to sleep with the word on your mind, your spirit continues to meditate on it even while your body is resting. The Holy Spirit will minister to you in your sleep. He will give you dreams, he will give you revelations, he will [music] work things out in the spirit realm while you are resting in the natural realm. I also want to address the people who are battling condemnation. Your mind is not at rest because you are constantly replaying your past mistakes. The enemy keeps showing you the highlight reel of your failures. Every [music] time you try to move forward, he reminds you of where you fell. Every time you try to pray, he tells you that you are not worthy. But Romans chapter 8:1 says, "There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, [music] who walk not after the flesh, but after the spirit." No condemnation. Not reduced condemnation, not occasional condemnation, no condemnation. If you are in Christ, you are free from the guilt and shame of your past. The enemy is called the accuser of the brethren. Revelation chapter 12:10 says, "He accuses us before God day and night." But the same verse says he was cast down. His accusations have no legal standing because the blood of Jesus has answered every charge against you. When the enemy brings up your past, remind him of his future. When he tells you what you did, tell him what Jesus did. When he shows you your sin, show him the cross. The cross is the final answer to every accusation. I prophesy to someone you are free. You are forgiven. You are justified. You are sanctified. You are a new creation. All things are passed away. All things have become new. Stop living like a prisoner when Jesus has declared you free. Let me share revelation with you. The mind of Christ is available to you. 1 Corinthians chapter 2:16 [music] says, "For who hath known the mind of the Lord that he may instruct him, but we have the mind of Christ." We have the mind of Christ. This is not something you are trying to get. This is something you already have. The mind of Christ is a mind of peace, wisdom, love, power, and sound thinking. When you renew your mind with the word of God, you are literally accessing the thoughts of Christ. You are downloading heaven's perspective. You are seeing your situation from God's point of view. This is why the scripture says in Romans chapter 12 verse 2, "And be not conformed to this world, but be you transformed by the renewing of your mind that you may prove what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God." Transformation happens in the mind. When your mind is renewed, your life is transformed. Beloved, I have shared with you the keys that will unlock the peace of God in your life, but these keys only work if you use them. You have to apply what you have heard. You have to put into practice the principles I have taught you. This is not just information. This is activation. I want to pray one final prayer over you, and I want you to receive it with all your heart. Lift up your hands one more time. Open your spirit. Position yourself to receive from heaven. Father, in the matchless name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace on behalf of every person who has been part of this ministry today. I thank you because you are the God of peace. You are Jehovah Shalom. You are the one who gives rest to the weary and strength to the weak. Right now, I release the peace of God into every troubled mind, every thought pattern that has been programmed by trauma, by disappointment, by fear, I command a divine reprogramming in the name of Jesus. Let the mind of Christ be activated in them. Let their thoughts align with heaven's thoughts. Let their perspective shift to your perspective. I speak to every spirit that has been assigned to torment the minds of your children. By the authority of the name of Jesus, by the power of the blood, by the fire of the Holy Ghost. I command you to leave now. Lose your hold. Release your grip. You have no authority. You have no power. You are defeated. Father, I decree supernatural sleep. I decree mental clarity. I decree emotional stability. I decree spiritual sensitivity. I decree that your peace, which surpasses all understanding, will guard their hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. Let there be healing in their emotions. Let there be restoration in their thought life. Let there be calmness in their spirit. From this day forward, they will not be dominated by anxiety. They will not be controlled by fear. They will not be tormented by worry. They are free in the name of Jesus. I prophesy that this week, they will experience a level of peace they have never known. Their sleep will be sweet. Their mind will be clear. Their spirit will be light. They will operate with divine wisdom. They will make decisions with confidence. They will walk in the assurance of your presence. Every chemical imbalance, every neurological disorder, every mental health challenge that the enemy is using as a weapon, I speak divine healing. Let there be restoration in the brain. Let there be balance in the body. Let there be wholeness in every area of their being. Father, I thank you because you are doing a new thing. You are making a way where there seems to be no way. You are bringing them into a season of rest, peace, and divine alignment. They will look back at this moment and know that this was their turning point. This was their breakthrough. This was their moment of liberation. I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I release it into the atmosphere. I declare it is done in heaven, and it is manifesting on earth. Let your kingdom come. Let your will be done in their lives as it is in heaven. [music] In the mighty, powerful, undefeated name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I have prayed. Amen and amen. Beloved, I speak peace to your mind. I speak calm to your spirit. You are not alone.
